declarations.description:
A dropdown for picking from a hierarchy: a form-associated trigger and a `c2-tree` inside a `c2-overlay` popover.
Everything the tree does (expansion, keyboard, checkboxes and their propagation, lazy branches) is the tree's own;
the select adds the trigger, the form value, search, and how the selection reads back.

Give it rows as data through `items` (the tree's `TreeNode` shape), or nest `c2-tree-item` elements in it, which
are slotted into the tree. The select has no intrinsic width: give the host a `width` and the trigger fills it.

- **Single** (default): a pick closes the dropdown. Picking the selected row again keeps it. `leaf-only` lets only
  rows without children be picked; a branch row then expands and collapses instead.
- **Multiple** (`multiple`): a row click toggles that row and the dropdown stays open, with a footer to clear or
  close it. `checkbox-selection` adds the tree's checkboxes, ticking a branch ticks its descendants as
  `selection-propagation` says, and `value-display` picks which ticked rows `value` holds. The trigger shows the
  values as chips, up to `max-chips` and then a `+n` count.
- **Search** (`searchable`): a field at the top of the dropdown filters the rows to the matches and their ancestors,
  which it expands; the matched text is marked when the rows come from `items`.

Keyboard: Enter, Space, ArrowDown or ArrowUp on the trigger opens the dropdown and moves focus to the selected row
(else the first), or to the search field. The tree then takes arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Enter and Space. In the
search field, ArrowDown moves to the first match and Enter picks it. Escape closes the dropdown and returns focus to
the trigger; Tab leaves and closes it. Backspace on the trigger removes the last value of a multiple select, and
clears a `clearable` single one.

`item-expand` and `item-load-error` from the inner tree reach the select's listeners as they are, so a lazy tree
(`loadChildren`, or `item-expand` in markup) works the same way as on `c2-tree`.

slots.description: The rows, as `c2-tree-item` elements, when the tree is authored in markup instead of through `items`.

members.name: field
members.description: Label and description handed down by an enclosing `c2-form-field`.

members.name: items
members.description: Rows to pick from. Leave empty and nest `c2-tree-item` elements instead to author the tree in markup.

members.name: value
members.description: Selected values. Written as `value="a;b"` in markup, read as `['a', 'b']` from the property.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the dropdown is showing. Set it to open or close the dropdown programmatically.

members.name: multiple
members.description: Allow several rows to be selected; the dropdown stays open after a pick and the trigger shows chips.

members.name: checkboxSelection
members.description: Shows a checkbox on every row. Implies `multiple`.

members.name: selectionPropagation
members.description: How a checkbox tick travels between a row and its relatives.

members.name: valueDisplay
members.description:
Which ticked rows `value` holds while checkboxes propagate: `parent` holds a fully ticked branch instead of its
descendants, `leaves` only the rows without children, `all` every ticked row.

members.name: leafOnly
members.description: Only rows without children can be picked; clicking a branch row expands or collapses it.

members.name: searchable
members.description: Adds a search field at the top of the dropdown that filters the rows.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Adds a button to the trigger that clears the selection.

members.name: showPath
members.description: Writes the selected row's ancestors before its label in the trigger (`Engineering / Platform`). Single selection only.

members.name: maxChips
members.description: How many chips a multiple select shows before a `+n` count. `0` shows a count of the selection instead.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown in the trigger while nothing is selected.

members.name: searchPlaceholder
members.description: Text of the search field while it is empty. Defaults to a built-in "Search".

members.name: readonly
members.description: Shows the current value but never opens the dropdown.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Dims the trigger and ignores interaction.

members.name: required
members.description: Keep at least one row selected: the form reports a missing value while nothing is.

members.name: name
members.description: Name used when the select participates in a form.

members.name: fitSize
members.description: Make the dropdown exactly as wide as the trigger instead of at least as wide.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the trigger and the tree.

members.name: ariaLabelledByAttr
members.description: Mirrors the host's `aria-labelledby` so the trigger re-renders when a label claims the element.

members.name: loadChildren
members.description: Resolves the children of a branch the first time it is expanded; see `c2-tree`'s `loadChildren`.

members.name: hasMarkupRows
members.description: Whether light-DOM rows are present, which switches the tree to the markup mode.

members.name: rowsVersion
members.description: Bumped whenever the tree's rows may have changed, so the trigger re-reads their labels.

members.name: expandedBeforeSearch
members.description: Expansion before a search took over, given back when the search clears.

members.name: plainActivation
members.description: Set by a plain click or Enter on a row of a multiple select without checkboxes, which then toggles that row.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: selectedNodes
members.description: The nodes `value` names, in tree order. Values the tree does not hold (a lazy branch not loaded yet) are left out.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Opens (`true`), closes (`false`) or flips the dropdown. Does nothing while disabled or read-only.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the selection, as the clear button does.

members.name: projectsValue
members.description: Whether `value` is a projection of the ticked rows rather than the ticked rows themselves.

members.name: #index
members.description:
Every row by value, in tree order. Read from the tree's rendered rows once there are any, which also covers
markup rows and children a lazy branch loaded; from `items` before the tree has rendered (and on the server).

members.name: #ordered
members.description: In tree order, with values the tree does not hold kept at the end.

members.name: #treeValue
members.description: The rows the tree should show ticked for `value`.

members.name: #valueOf
members.description: The `value` for the rows the tree shows ticked.

members.name: handleTreeClickCapture
members.default: { handleEvent: (event: MouseEvent) => { this.plainActivation = !(event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.shiftKey) }, capture: true, }

members.name: handleTreeKeydownCapture
members.default: { handleEvent: (event: KeyboardEvent) => { this.plainActivation = event.key === 'Enter' this.spacePressedInTree = event.key === ' ' }, capture: true, }

members.name: applyFilter
members.description:
Hides every row that neither matches nor leads to a match, and expands the ancestors of the matches. The tree
drops a `hidden` row from its keyboard order, so the arrows only walk what is shown.

members.name: firstMatch
members.description: The first row a search would pick: shown, enabled, and pickable under `leaf-only`.

members.name: #propagate
members.description: What clicking `value`'s checkbox would leave ticked.

members.name: handleHostActivation
members.description: WebKit associates form labels but does not focus a form-associated custom element when its label activates it.

members.name: handleFieldClick
members.description: A click on the chips or the chevron opens the dropdown, as a click on the trigger text does.

members.name: focusInside
members.description: On open, focus goes to the search field, else to the selected row (expanding its ancestors), else the first row.

members.name: handleOverlayBeforeToggle
members.description:
Runs before the dropdown hides, while a row can still hold focus. A slotted row is light DOM, which the browser
does not count as inside the popover, so it would not hand focus back to the trigger: focus moves back here.
Focus that already left (Tab, a click elsewhere) is not taken back.

members.name: handleOverlayFocusOut
members.description: Closes the dropdown when focus leaves it for something else: Tab and Shift+Tab out of it.

members.name: syncLabelText
members.description: Reads the text of whatever labels the host: `aria-labelledby` first, then any associated `<label>`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the new `value`, `detail.nodes` the nodes it names. Does not bubble: several components fire `selection-change`, so a listener belongs on the element itself.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired with `selection-change`, after `value` is updated, so `v-model`, `ngModel` and other form bindings work.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired with `input`: the select commits on every pick.
